fallback_target_shape: Keep entrypoints thin and move decisions into named application services.
Wrap side-effecting dependencies behind adapters with timeout and failure contracts.

default_first_slice.name: first_bounded_capability_slice
default_first_slice.goal: Extract one useful capability with explicit input/output and tests.
steps: Select one central callable with low external coupling.
Define input/output schema from signature and tests.
Move side effects behind a named adapter.

default_items: Do not rewrite the whole project before one slice has passing contract tests.

default_steps: Create or extend focused tests for slice `{slice_name}`; current detected test files: {existing_tests}.
Add one happy-path contract test and one malformed-input or failed-dependency test.
Record before/after ProjectMapReport to confirm fewer mixed responsibilities or clearer capability boundary.

rules.reason: control flow is implicit and hard to replay
too many responsibilities behind one callable
retry or replay can duplicate side effects
candidate can become a first bounded pipeline step
